main_measure.name: pooled mean of forecast/10 x (10-bar return minus coin's mean 10-bar return), before costs
main_measure.threshold: mean > 0 with t >= 2 over at least 30 cases (confirm); mean < 0 with t <= -2 over at least 30 cases (reject)

supporting_check.name: mean signed excess return, upper half of |forecast| minus lower half

decided_by: The mean is above 0 with t >= 2 over at least 30 cases, and the upper half of |forecast| earns more than the lower half.
reading: The coin's mean 10-bar return is taken over all grid cells (0, 10, 20, ... of each window, return inside the window) of all its windows; the upper half of |forecast| is the cells strictly above its median and the lower half those at or below; the regime side is read from the recorded `regime` column.
